description_zh: 夜间路口，Zoox 自动驾驶车辆在左转车道等红灯时被后方试图变道的车辆（ego）追尾。ego 作为移动车辆，直行接近静止前车时发生碰撞，测试其能否避免追尾。

source_snippets: A Zoox vehicle in autonomy was fully stopped with brake lights illuminated in the left turn lane at a red traffic light waiting to complete a left hand turn
Vehicle 2 attempted to make a lane change to the right and struck the rear of the Zoox vehicle
MOVEMENT PRECEDING COLLISION: STOPPED (VEH 1), CHANGING LANES (VEH 2)
evidence.reason: 报告中 Vehicle 2 是唯一移动的 car，追尾静止的 Zoox，具有测试价值（避免追尾静止前车），故选 Vehicle 2 为 ego。Zoox 作为静止 NPC 位于同车道前方。
